notes: I replaced the sparse-knot interpolation with a dense piecewise-linear model built from all observed points (E1+E2), since the slope analysis shows the box is essentially piecewise-linear with many breakpoints (slope ~-3.4 near 0, ~-0.85 mid, ~-0.18 far tails). Extrapolation uses the observed tail slopes (-0.533 left, -0.180 right).
